verdict.line: You lose reps where you get caught by Test of Spirit near her tentacles and eat the echo damage; you win once Blade of the Ruined King and stacked Ionian Fervor let you out-trade her in extended fights.

brief.thesis: Illaoi has no mobility beyond W (Harsh Lesson) leaping to a target and the spirit she pulls with E (Test of Spirit) — she cannot chase you once you dash away with Q (Bladesurge). Her entire lane threat is landing E near a wall or Vessel-spawned tentacle so the spirit echo and tentacle swings stack on top of her damage. If you deny that setup you dictate every trade; if you get caught standing in it, the 554-game sample's 47.8% win rate is exactly what you'd expect.

tell.watch: Illaoi's E cooldown and nearby tentacles

theirWindow.when: E is up and you're near terrain/tentacles
theirWindow.what: She rips your spirit with E (Test of Spirit); staying close to a tentacle or wall means the spirit echoes damage back to you and you risk becoming a Vessel if it dies or you run too far. Walk away from walls the instant she casts it.

yourWindow.when: Ionian Fervor passive is at 4 stacks
yourWindow.what: At max passive stacks you gain bonus damage on hit on top of the attack speed. Load stacks by poking with E (Flawless Duet) or an auto, then dash in with Q (Bladesurge) — if she's Marked from your E, the Q kill/mark refreshes its cooldown for a second dash.

start.why: Run in 88.3% of games at 47.1% win rate — the extra sustain matters because Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) has a 4-second cooldown and she'll poke every time it's up.

boots.why: Taken in 82% of games (48.4% win rate). Illaoi's tentacles, W, and autos are all physical damage, so flat armor directly blunts her poke-and-leap pattern.

core.why: Highest win-rate core path in the data (62.5% over 88 games with this build); on-hit current-health damage lets you duel through her tentacle sustain.
Second item on both top-performing build paths; the on-hit proc stacks with your passive's attack speed for faster trades.
Completes the 62.5% win-rate path; the attack speed and magic on-hit keep snowballing your Ionian Fervor stacks in extended fights.

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the top rune page (35.1% pick, 50.2% win rate); Conqueror's stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the prolonged-trade pattern this matchup turns into once you're online.

summoners.why: Run in 91.3% of games at 46.9% win rate — the standard pick. Ignite punishes her sustain from tentacle healing during all-ins, and Flash covers your lack of an escape outside of Q (Bladesurge)'s fixed 600 range.

playing.title: Stay off walls when her E is up
playing.detail: Illaoi's passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassable terrain. If E (Test of Spirit) catches you next to a wall, the spirit echo plus tentacle swings compound fast — fight in open lane space instead.

playing.title: Load passive stacks before engaging
playing.detail: Poke with E (Flawless Duet) or an auto to build Ionian Fervor stacks, then dash in with Q (Bladesurge) once you're at 4 stacks for the bonus on-hit damage.

playing.title: Use E's mark to chain Q resets
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anyone caught between the blades. Follow with Q (Bladesurge) — hitting a Marked target refreshes Q's cooldown, letting you dash again immediately.

playing.title: Respect her 4-second W cadence
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson's short cooldown means she can leap-and-swing on a near-permanent loop once in melee range. Hold your spacing at your E/Q range rather than standing in hers.

playing.title: W to tank her all-in windows
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) reduces physical damage taken while charging — use it when she commits W (Harsh Lesson) plus tentacles into you, then release for the trade.

playing.title: Don't let her spirit die near tentacles
playing.detail: If the spirit from Test of Spirit dies or you stray too far from it, you become a Vessel spawning tentacles against you — kill the spirit fast or disengage entirely.

playing.title: Snowball the extended trade once itemized
playing.detail: Once Blade of The Ruined King is up, extended duels tip your way through on-hit damage and healing — look to re-engage rather than reset after level 9.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — tentacle positioning, passive-stack timing, Q reset chains — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.
